note: Both sets correctly capture the 96.00 oz (2.721 kg) minimum starting water weight and the Figure 9 full-points (80 oz / 2300 g) and no-points (16 oz / 450 g) thresholds, and both contain several redundant restatements of the same facts. Set B additionally captures the reduced-points band (16 oz < Weight < 80 oz), which Set A omits entirely despite it being a key scoring condition. However, Set B includes one unsupported claim quoting 'The water shall be vaporized in a single task' — the source says 'vaporized in a single container', so the quote and value are misread/invented. Set A is error-free but thinner, missing both the reduced-points range and the single-container requirement.
